The this_artifact, regeneration_delta_rows, regeneration_delta_assay_types and regeneration_delta_note fields, and the generator re-run asserted in upstream_intermediate, were all measured locally on 2026-08-31 against data/iedb_tcell_export_2026-06-26.csv/tcell_full_v3.csv, a 1.34 GB gitignored raw export. assay_mix_review.ruling: Accepted as-is by the maintainer on 2026-08-31 (Ruling R2). These rows stand as negatives under the current exclusion rationale; no further exclusion is applied by this sidecar. Signing this sidecar blesses the current assay mix. The ruling is restated here in full rather than cited, deliberately: an attestation must not rest its authority on a document that a reader of a clone cannot open.

upstream_generator_run.note: The June generation run that produced the 34358-row INTERMEDIATE, which is this block's own output_file and the top-level input_file. Every other field, including filter_stats, git_sha, timestamp, input_sha256 and output_checksum_sha256, is byte-for-byte as recorded in June.
